args.lesson: Verdict PURSUE_IF (Gumroad). Official pages show: Canada CAD bank payouts; fees of 10%+$0.50 direct or 30% via Discover; Gumroad acts as merchant of record and handles sales tax; USD 100 minimum payout; 7-day hold; Stripe KYC. Platform-managed collection does not depend on our missing finance adapter. It still needs a founder seller account, and Treasury verification of payouts is unconfigured. What worked: the help page is an Inertia JSON shell, so a double html.unescape plus a decode of escaped tags recovered the full 18 KB text where plain tag stripping gave 47 chars. Gap: the Prohibited Products page was not read. Next time, decode embedded JSON before declaring a page empty. Use the USD 100 payout floor to size any price test, since one small sale cannot settle.
